articles.title: Hong Kong Upgrades Its Hot Weather Warning System to Better Protect Workers
articles.summary: Starting August 29, Hong Kong's Labour Department made its Work Heat Warning System stronger by adding two new conditions that can trigger a higher alert level. One of these new conditions is activated when the Hong Kong Observatory records extreme high temperatures in a given area. Before this change, the system used fewer measurements to decide whether to raise the warning. The update is meant to help outdoor workers stay safer during very hot days. Some weather experts had suggested the government also measure wet-bulb globe temperature — a way of checking how heat and humidity together affect the human body — but the department said it would keep reviewing this idea.

lv1: What did Hong Kong's Labour Department change about its hot weather warning system on August 29? (香港勞工處在8月29日對工作暑熱警告系統做了什麼改變？)
Which government department in Hong Kong measures the temperature to trigger a higher warning level? (香港哪個政府部門負責量度溫度以決定是否提升警告級別？)
lv2: Why do you think it is important to have a heat warning system for outdoor workers, and how might the new changes make it more effective? (你認為為戶外工人設立暑熱警告系統為何重要？新的改變如何令系統更有效？)
What is wet-bulb globe temperature, and why might some experts think it is a better way to measure heat danger than regular temperature? (濕球黑球溫度是什麼？為何部分專家認為它比一般溫度更能反映高溫危險？)
lv3: Should the government make it a legal requirement for employers to stop outdoor work when heat warnings reach a certain level? Consider the perspectives of workers, employers, and the economy. (政府是否應立法規定僱主在暑熱警告達到某一級別時強制停止戶外工作？請從工人、僱主及經濟角度分析。)

Climate change is making summers hotter every year. Do you think current warning systems are enough to protect workers in the long run, or do bigger changes in society and policy need to happen? (氣候變化令夏天愈來愈熱，你認為現有的警告系統長遠而言是否足夠保護工人，還是社會和政策需要更大的改變？)

articles.title: A Famous Cross-Border Bus Serving Hong Kong and Shenzhen for 30 Years Is Coming to an End
articles.summary: A well-known cross-border shuttle bus known as the 'Huang Ba' has been running between Lo Wu in Hong Kong and Huanggang in Shenzhen since March 1997. For nearly three decades, it carried Hong Kong residents, tourists, and Mainland visitors travelling between the two cities. However, with the brand-new Huanggang Port set to open very soon, the old shuttle bus service will no longer be needed. The route served not just individual travellers but also about one-third of its passengers came from organised Mainland tour groups visiting Hong Kong. The closure marks the end of an important chapter in cross-border travel history between Hong Kong and Shenzhen.

lv1: How many years has the 'Huang Ba' cross-border shuttle bus been running between Hong Kong and Shenzhen? (「皇巴」跨境穿梭巴士在香港和深圳之間行走了多少年？)
Why is the 'Huang Ba' shuttle bus stopping its service? (「皇巴」穿梭巴士為何要停止服務？)
lv2: How do cross-border transport links like the 'Huang Ba' help people living in Hong Kong and Shenzhen, and what might change for travellers after it closes? (像「皇巴」這類跨境交通連繫如何幫助香港和深圳的居民？它停辦後旅客會有什麼改變？)
Why do you think the opening of a new, modern port like the new Huanggang Port would make an old shuttle bus service unnecessary? (你認為新皇崗口岸的開通，為何會令舊有的穿梭巴士服務變得不再必要？)
lv3: Transport links between Hong Kong and Mainland China have grown a lot over the decades. Do you think better cross-border connections strengthen or weaken Hong Kong's unique identity? Give reasons for your view. (香港與內地的交通連繫數十年來大幅增加，你認為更便捷的跨境聯繫是否會加強或削弱香港的獨特身份？請說明理由。)
When historical transport services like the 'Huang Ba' close, should governments or communities make efforts to preserve their memory? Why or why not? (當「皇巴」這類具歷史意義的交通服務結束時，政府或社區是否應努力保存其歷史記憶？為什麼？)

articles.title: 尼泊爾中國邊境發生嚴重泥石流 逾1800人罹難或失蹤
articles.summary: 尼泊爾北部與中國西藏接壤的邊境地區近日發生大規模泥石流災難，洶湧的山泥摧毀沿途建築，更令西藏吉隆口岸一帶夷為平地。截至最新消息，罹難及失蹤人數合共超過1800人，搜救工作仍在持續進行。更令人擔憂的是，災區附近形成了一個堰塞湖，當局警告湖水可能在短期內潰決，屆時或釀成更嚴重的二次災難。中國國家主席習近平主持政治局會議，要求全力展開搜救工作，並協助搜尋所有失聯人員，包括在場的外國人士。

lv1: 今次泥石流災難發生在哪個地區？
截至最新消息，今次災難共有多少人罹難或失蹤？
lv2: 什麼是堰塞湖？為何當局擔心它會造成更大的危險？
為什麼山區地帶特別容易發生泥石流？請嘗試從地理角度解釋。
lv3: 面對自然災害，政府、國際社會和個人各應承擔什麼責任？請從不同角度分析。
隨著氣候變化加劇，山泥傾瀉等自然災害愈來愈頻繁。人類應如何在發展與保護自然環境之間取得平衡？

articles.title: 美國29個州聯合控告Meta 指旗下社交平台危害青少年身心健康
articles.summary: 美國共有29個州的州政府聯合向科技巨頭Meta提出法律訴訟，指控其旗下的社交平台Facebook及Instagram對青少年用戶造成身心健康損害。各州政府認為，Meta的平台設計刻意令用戶沉迷，令青少年花費大量時間在平台上，影響睡眠、學習及心理健康。這是迄今美國規模最大的一次州政府聯合行動之一，標誌著社會對科技公司如何保護未成年用戶的關注與日俱增。事件引發外界廣泛討論，如何監管社交媒體對兒童及青少年的影響成為焦點議題。

lv1: 今次聯合控告Meta的行動，共有多少個美國州份參與？
控告主要針對Meta旗下的哪兩個社交平台？
lv2: 各州政府為何認為Meta的社交平台對青少年有害？平台的設計如何可能令人上癮？
為什麼政府需要介入監管社交媒體公司，而不能單靠家長或學校來保護青少年？
lv3: 社交媒體公司是否應該為用戶（尤其是青少年）的心理健康問題負上法律責任？請從不同立場分析。
限制青少年使用社交媒體，是保護他們還是剝奪他們的資訊自由？你認為應該如何在兩者之間取得平衡？
